_comment: SEED TEMPLATE — copy to <satellite root>/opencode.json and customize.
Parcel/ptp agents are defined as VS Code custom agent files in .devops/agents/
(parcel.agent.md = selectable, ptp-*.subagent.md = subagents) — NOT in this file.
The 'agent' block below is optional (e.g. a 'plan' mode). A satellite that does not
use opencode agents should delete the entire 'agent' section.
JSON has no comments — notes live in this _comment array; delete it when done.

plan.description: Planning mode. Consults wiki first before any codebase search.
plan.prompt: You are in planning mode. Before searching the codebase or spawning any subagent, you MUST follow the AGENTS.md directive: STOP and read .wiki/ first. All research must start at .wiki/core/00-system-index.md. Only search the codebase if the wiki does not contain the answer. When using subagents, explicitly instruct them to follow the same wiki-first workflow.

_example_minimal_subagent__delete_or_ren.description: Example opencode sub-agent. NOTE: parcel/ptp agents now live as VS Code .agent.md / .subagent.md files in .devops/agents/ (frontmatter in-file) — only add opencode agents here if you need opencode-CLI-specific agents.

agent._note_parcel_agents: Parcel/ptp agents are defined as VS Code custom agent files in .devops/agents/ (parcel.agent.md = selectable; ptp-*.subagent.md = subagents; wiki-writer.agent.md = selectable; wiki-verifier.subagent.md = subagent). Each carries YAML frontmatter (description/tools/model/user-invocable) + the PREFIX-LOCKED prefix from base-context.md. Models per the delegation map in base-context.md.
